library(tidyverse)

# The following setting is important, do not omit.
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE);

# --- Deteccao portatil da raiz do projeto (substitui setwd hardcoded) ---
project_root <- function() {
  if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    input_file <- knitr::current_input()
    if (nzchar(input_file)) {
      return(dirname(dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))))
    }
  }
  args <- commandArgs(FALSE)
  file_arg <- args[grepl("^--file=", args, fixed = TRUE)][1]
  if (!is.na(file_arg) && nzchar(file_arg)) {
    return(dirname(dirname(sub("^--file=", "", file_arg))))
  }
  frames <- sys.frames()
  ofiles <- vapply(frames, function(f) {
    o <- attr(f, "ofile")
    if (is.null(o)) NA_character_ else as.character(o)
  }, character(1))
  ofiles <- ofiles[!is.na(ofiles)]
  if (length(ofiles) > 0) return(dirname(dirname(ofiles[length(ofiles)])))
  getwd()
}
setwd(normalizePath(project_root(), winslash = "/"))

dark2_extended <- function(n, groups = NULL) {
  if (n > length(brasil_nativo)) {
    stop(paste("MÃ¡ximo de", length(brasil_nativo), "categorias suportado sem interpolaÃ§Ã£o."))
  }
  selected_colors <- brasil_nativo[1:n]
  if (!is.null(groups)) {
    names(selected_colors) <- groups
  }
  return(selected_colors)
}

# Carregar pacotes
library(ggplot2)

# 1. PreparaÃ§Ã£o dos dados
a <- dados_gerais[,c(bacterias_microbioma, "lauren_type")] %>%
  mutate(across(c(bacterias_microbioma), ~ . + 1))

#retirando virus

a$sample <- row.names(a)

dados <- a %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(sample, lauren_type),
    names_to = "genus",
    values_to = "counts"
  )

# 
matriz_wide <- dados %>%
  dplyr::select(genus, sample, counts) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = counts) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genus")

col_data <- dados %>%
  distinct(sample, lauren_type) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample")


# 6. Score de abundÃ¢ncia
calc_score <- function(tab){
  tab[tab == 0] <- NA
  pos <- matrix(as.numeric(unlist(tab)), nrow = nrow(tab))
  rownames(pos) <- rownames(tab); colnames(pos) <- colnames(tab)
  for (i in 1:ncol(tab)){
    pos[order(tab[, i], decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA), i] <- 1:sum(!is.na(tab[, i]))
  }
  freq <- rowMeans(!is.na(pos))
  score <- rowMeans(pos, na.rm = TRUE) * (1.1 - freq)
  data.frame(genus = rownames(tab), score = score, freq = freq)
}

tabela.m <- purrr::map_dfr(unique(dados$lauren_type), function(cond) {
  subset <- dados %>%
    filter(lauren_type == cond) %>%
    dplyr::select(genus, sample, counts) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = counts) %>%
    column_to_rownames("genus") %>%
    as.matrix()

  rel <- prop.table(subset, 1)
  sc <- calc_score(subset)

  counts_m <- reshape2::melt(subset)
  colnames(counts_m) <- c("genus", "sample", "counts")

  rel_m <- reshape2::melt(rel)
  colnames(rel_m) <- c("genus", "sample", "relative")

  left_join(counts_m, rel_m, by = c("genus", "sample")) %>%
    left_join(sc, by = "genus") %>%
    mutate(condition = cond)
})

#nÃºmeros de genes para identificaÃ§Ã£o
topnumber = 15

# 7. Top 15 por score
top15 <- tabela.m %>%
  group_by(condition, genus) %>%
  summarise(score = mean(score), freq = mean(freq), abundance = sum(relative), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = score, n = topnumber)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)
library(RColorBrewer)

# AbundÃ¢ncia relativa
rel_abund <- prop.table(as.matrix(dados_gerais[, row.names(df_tax_wide)]), 1) %>% as.data.frame()
rel_abund$files <- rownames(rel_abund)


# Long format + taxonomia + grupo
rel_abund_long <- pivot_longer(rel_abund, -files, names_to = "Genero", values_to = "Abundance") %>%

  left_join(dados_gerais[, c("files", "lauren_type")], by = "files")
rel_abund_long$Sample = rel_abund_long$files

#===============================
# 1. GRÃFICO DE PIZZA - Top 10 Phyla
#===============================

# 1. Calcular abundÃ¢ncia total por filo
df_pizza <- rel_abund_long %>%
  mutate(phylum = ifelse(is.na(phylum), "Unclassified", phylum)) %>%
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundancia = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Abundancia))

# 2. Selecionar os 15 filos mais abundantes (excluindo "Unclassified")
top15_phyla <- df_pizza %>%
  filter(phylum != "Unclassified") %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(phylum)

# 3. Reagrupar: manter top 15 e agrupar o restante como "Others"
df_pizza <- df_pizza %>%
  mutate(PhylumGroup = ifelse(phylum %in% top15_phyla, phylum, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(PhylumGroup) %>%
  summarise(Abundancia = sum(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Abundancia)) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = Abundancia / sum(Abundancia) * 100,
    ymax = cumsum(Percent),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0),
    ymid = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    legend_label = paste0(PhylumGroup, " (", round(Percent, 1), "%)"),
    PhylumGroup = factor(PhylumGroup, levels = c(setdiff(PhylumGroup, "Others"), "Others"))
  )

# 4. Plotar grÃ¡fico de pizza com categoria "Others" e legenda formatada
plot_pizza <- ggplot(df_pizza, aes(x = 1, y = Percent, fill = PhylumGroup)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, title = "Phyla")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = dark2_extended(length(unique(df_pizza$PhylumGroup))),
    labels = df_pizza$legend_label,
    breaks = c(setdiff(df_pizza$PhylumGroup, "Others"), "Others")
  )

print(plot_pizza)

# Etapa 4: gerar legenda com percentuais GAC, PTT e Total
family_legend <- df_family_plot %>%
  group_by(FamilyGroup, lauren_type) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(RelAbund), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lauren_type, values_from = Total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = round(Intestinal + Diffuse, 1),
    Percent_Intestinal = round(Intestinal / Total * 100, 1),
    Percent_Diffuse = round(Diffuse / Total * 100, 1),
    Percent_Total = round(Total / sum(Total) * 100, 1),
    Label = paste0(FamilyGroup, " (Intestinal: ", Percent_Intestinal, "%, Diffuse: ", Percent_Diffuse, "%, Total: ", Percent_Total, "%)")
  )

# Etapa 5: definir ordem dos fatores (incluindo â€œOthersâ€ no final)
family_levels <- c(setdiff(family_legend$FamilyGroup, "Others"), "Others")
family_labels_fmt <- family_legend %>%
  filter(FamilyGroup %in% family_levels) %>%
  arrange(factor(FamilyGroup, levels = family_levels)) %>%
  pull(Label)

# Etapa 6: gerar grÃ¡fico
plot_family <- ggplot(df_family_plot, aes(x = Sample, y = RelAbund, fill = factor(FamilyGroup, levels = family_levels))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ lauren_type, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Relative abundance (%)", x = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = dark2_extended(length(family_levels)),
    labels = family_labels_fmt,
    breaks = family_levels
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 6, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE, title = "Families"))

print(plot_family)

# Etapa 1: calcular abundÃ¢ncia total por gÃªnero
df_genus <- rel_abund_long %>%
  mutate(Genero = ifelse(is.na(Genero) | is.nan(Genero), "Unclassified", Genero)) %>%
  group_by(Genero) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbund = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbund))

# Etapa 2: selecionar os 15 Genera mais abundantes, excluindo "Unclassified"
top15_genera <- df_genus %>%
  filter(Genero != "Unclassified") %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(Genero)

# Etapa 3: incluir "Others", calcular abundÃ¢ncia relativa por amostra
df_genus_plot <- rel_abund_long %>%
  mutate(Genero = ifelse(is.na(Genero) | is.nan(Genero), "Unclassified", Genero)) %>%
  mutate(GenusGroup = ifelse(Genero %in% top15_genera, Genero, "Others")) %>%
  group_by(Sample, lauren_type, GenusGroup) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(RelAbund = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()


# Etapa 4: legenda com percentuais GAC, PTT e Total
genus_legend <- df_genus_plot %>%
  group_by(GenusGroup, lauren_type) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(RelAbund), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lauren_type, values_from = Total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = round(Intestinal + Diffuse, 1),
    Percent_Intestinal = round(Intestinal / Total * 100, 1),
    Percent_Diffuse = round(Diffuse / Total * 100, 1),
    Percent_Total = round(Total / sum(Total) * 100, 1),

# Etapa 5: definir ordem dos fatores e rÃ³tulos formatados

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",

    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5),

  ) +

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbreak)
library(ggpubr)

# Transformar bacteria_abundance em formato longo
bacteria_long <-as.data.frame(dados_gerais[,c(unique(bac_high_class$bac), "lauren_type")]) %>%
  pivot_longer(-lauren_type, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundance")

# Calcular mÃ©dias das proporÃ§Ãµes por grupo (Normal/Tumor)
mean_proportions <- bacteria_long %>%
  group_by(Taxon, lauren_type) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Teste de Wilcoxon para cada tÃ¡xon
wilcox_results <- bacteria_long %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(Abundance ~ lauren_type)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# Calcular diferenÃ§a de mÃ©dias e intervalo de confianÃ§a 95%
# Calcular mÃ©dias das proporÃ§Ãµes por grupo (GAC e PTT)
mean_proportions <- bacteria_long %>%
  group_by(Taxon, lauren_type) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Teste de Wilcoxon para cada tÃ¡xon
wilcox_results <- bacteria_long %>%
  group_by(Taxon) %>%
  summarise(p_value = wilcox.test(Abundance ~ lauren_type)$p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# Calcular diferenÃ§a de mÃ©dias e intervalo de confianÃ§a 95%
diff_means <- mean_proportions %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = lauren_type, values_from = Mean_Abundance) %>%
  mutate(Diff = Intestinal - Diffuse) %>%
  left_join(wilcox_results, by = "Taxon") %>%
  mutate(lower = Diff - 1.96 * sd(Diff, na.rm = TRUE),
         upper = Diff + 1.96 * sd(Diff, na.rm = TRUE),
         Higher_in = ifelse(Diff > 0, "Intestinal", "Diffuse"))

# Definir ordem fixa dos tÃ¡xons
taxon_order <- diff_means$Taxon

library(ggh4x)

# GrÃ¡fico de barras das mÃ©dias de proporÃ§Ã£o por grupo (quebra de eixo)

p1 <- ggplot(mean_proportions, aes(x = factor(Taxon, levels = taxon_order), y = Mean_Abundance, fill = lauren_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 7, 70, 700, 7000), trans = "log1p") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Intestinal" = "#B22222", "Diffuse" = "#008080")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Taxon", y = "Mean proportion (log scale)", fill = "Group") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  force_panelsizes(rows = c(0.6, 0.4))

p1


library(ggplot2)

# Criar um novo dataframe para os pontos fora dos limites do eixo X
out_of_bounds <- diff_means %>%
  filter(Diff < -200 | Diff > 200)  # Seleciona os valores que estÃ£o fora do intervalo

# GrÃ¡fico principal
p2 <- ggplot(diff_means, aes(x = Diff, y = factor(Taxon, levels = taxon_order))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Higher_in), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper, color = Higher_in), height = 0.2) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",

library(MASS)

  "IFNG", "TNF", "IL6", "IL1B", "IL10", "TGFB1",
  "CXCL8", "CCL2", "CCL5", "FOXP3", "CD163", "CD68", "CD86",
  "MS4A1", "CD83", "STAT3", "MYD88", "NFKB1",
  "B2M", "HLA.A", "IDO1", "VEGFA", "PIGR", "SOX9"
)

#pode tambem adicionar 1 e tirar o log2
dados_completo <- dados_gerais %>%  
  mutate(across(all_of(c(unique(bac_high_class$bac), genes_literature)), ~ log2(. + 1))) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(c(genes_literature, unique(bac_high_class$bac))), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(unique(bac_high_class$bac), genes_literature, "lauren_type")))


dados_completo <- dados_completo %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ as.numeric(factor(.))))

library(ggcorrplot)

# Matriz de correlaÃ§Ã£o
cor_AB_matrix <- cor(dados_completo, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

# Definir as correlaÃ§Ãµes dentro dos conjuntos codificantes e nÃ£o codificantes como NA
# Defina como NA a correlaÃ§Ã£o dentro do conjunto codificante
cor_AB_matrix[c(genes_literature, "lauren_type"), c(genes_literature, "lauren_type")] <- NA
# Defina como NA a correlaÃ§Ã£o dentro do conjunto nÃ£o codificante
cor_AB_matrix[bac_high_class$bac,bac_high_class$bac] <- NA
# Agora, selecione a submatriz apenas das correlaÃ§Ãµes entre os conjuntos codificantes e nÃ£o codificantes
cor_AB_matrix <- cor_AB_matrix[c(genes_literature, "lauren_type"), bac_high_class$bac]
# Matriz de p-valores
p.mat <- cor_pmat(dados_completo)

# Definir as correlaÃ§Ãµes dentro dos conjuntos codificantes e nÃ£o codificantes como NA
# Defina como NA a correlaÃ§Ã£o dentro do conjunto codificante
p.mat[c(genes_literature, "lauren_type"), c(genes_literature, "lauren_type")] <- NA
# Defina como NA a correlaÃ§Ã£o dentro do conjunto nÃ£o codificante
p.mat[bac_high_class$bac,bac_high_class$bac] <- NA
# Agora, selecione a submatriz apenas das correlaÃ§Ãµes entre os conjuntos codificantes e nÃ£o codificantes
p.mat <- p.mat[c(genes_literature, "lauren_type"), bac_high_class$bac]

#ESTRATEGIA
p.mat[abs(cor_AB_matrix) <= abs(0.3)] <- 1
p.mat[abs(p.mat) > abs(0.05)] <- 1
cor_AB_matrix[abs(p.mat) > abs(0.05)] <- 0



gg_corr <- ggcorrplot(t(cor_AB_matrix),
                      p.mat = t(p.mat),
                      sig.level = 0.05,
                      insig = "blank",               # Esconde correlaÃ§Ãµes nÃ£o significativas
                      type = "full",                 # Matriz completa (nÃ£o sÃ³ triÃ¢ngulo)
                      lab = TRUE,                    # Mostra valores numÃ©ricos
                      lab_size = 2.5,
                      tl.cex = 10,                    # Tamanho dos nomes das variÃ¡veis
                      colors = c("#B22222", "white", "#008080"),
                      outline.color = "gray",
                      ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_gray) + theme(aspect.ratio = 0.3)


cor_AB_matrix = as.data.frame(cor_AB_matrix)
cor_AB_matrix$gene = rownames(cor_AB_matrix)
write_xlsx(cor_AB_matrix, path = "gg_corr.xlsx")

resultado_long$lauren_type <- factor(resultado_long$lauren_type, levels = unique(resultado_long$lauren_type))

# Normalizar os valores de fraÃ§Ã£o dentro de cada amostra

# Agora, selecione a submatriz apenas das correlaÃ§Ãµes entre os conjuntos codificantes e nÃ£o codificantes
p.mat <- p.mat[genes_literature, cell_vector_signif]

#ESTRATEGIA
p.mat[abs(cor_AB_matrix) <= 0.3] <- 1

#correlacao_deconvolucao_GAC
#correlacao_deconvolucao_PTT
correlacao_deconvolucao_diffuse = ggcorrplot(t(cor_AB_matrix),
                      p.mat = t(p.mat),
                      sig.level = 0.05,
                      insig = "blank",               # Esconde correlaÃ§Ãµes nÃ£o significativas
                      type = "full",                 # Matriz completa (nÃ£o sÃ³ triÃ¢ngulo)
                      lab = TRUE,                    # Mostra valores numÃ©ricos
                      lab_size = 2.3,
                      tl.cex = 10,                    # Tamanho dos nomes das variÃ¡veis
                      tl.srt = 55,
                      colors = c("#B22222", "white", "#008080"),
                      outline.color = "gray",
                      ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_gray) + theme(aspect.ratio = 0.5)



print(correlacao_deconvolucao_GAC)
print(correlacao_deconvolucao_diffuse)

cor_AB_matrix = as.data.frame(cor_AB_matrix)
cor_AB_matrix$gene = rownames(cor_AB_matrix)
write_xlsx(as.data.frame(cor_AB_matrix), path = "correlacao_deconvolucao_GAC.xlsx")

# Convertendo a tabela para data frame, caso nÃ£o seja
# 1. Formatar dados
resultado_df <- as.data.frame(dados_gerais[, c(celulas_deconvolucao, "type")]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  gather(key = "cell_type", value = "fraction", -type, -sample)

# 2. Total de fraÃ§Ãµes por amostra (usado na legenda)
total_fractions <- resultado_df %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(fraction, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Filtrar apenas cÃ©lulas significantes
resultado_signif <- resultado_df %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% cell_vector_signif)

# 4. Para legenda: calcular proporÃ§Ã£o real sobre total (incluindo cÃ©lulas que nÃ£o serÃ£o plotadas)
legenda_df <- resultado_signif %>%
  left_join(total_fractions, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(real_fraction = fraction / total * 100)

cell_legend <- legenda_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, type) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(real_fraction), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = total, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = GAC + PTT,
    Percent_GAC = round(GAC / Total * 100, 1),
    Percent_PTT = round(PTT / Total * 100, 1),
    Percent_Total = round(Total / sum(Total) * 100, 1),
    label = paste0(cell_type, " (GAC: ", Percent_GAC, "%, PTT: ", Percent_PTT, "%, Total: ", Percent_Total, "%)")
  )

# 5. Para grÃ¡fico: normalizar fraÃ§Ã£o apenas entre as cÃ©lulas significantes
fractions_signif <- resultado_signif %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(norm_fraction = fraction / sum(fraction) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# 6. Legendas organizadas
cell_levels <- cell_vector_signif
cell_labels_fmt <- cell_legend %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% cell_levels) %>%
  arrange(factor(cell_type, levels = cell_levels)) %>%
  pull(label)

# 7. Plotar grÃ¡fico com fraÃ§Ãµes normalizadas
fracoescelulares_deconvolucao = ggplot(fractions_signif, aes(x = sample, y = norm_fraction, fill = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_levels))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_grid(~ type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = dark2_extended(length(cell_levels)),
    labels = cell_labels_fmt,
    breaks = cell_levels) +
  labs(
    x = "Samples",
    y = "Relative fraction (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
   # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
     axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3, nrow = 6, byrow = TRUE, title = "Cells", position = "bottom"))


## concolidaÃ§Ã£o figuras

final_plot <- ggdraw(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +  # Reduzi o ylim para ajustarmos melhor o espaÃ§o

  # Linha 1 (GrÃ¡ficos acima)
  draw_plot(wilcoxon_deconvolucao,           x = 0.00,  y = 0.70, width = 1.00, height = 0.28) +
  draw_plot(fracoescelulares_deconvolucao,   x = 0.00,  y = 0.35, width = 1.00, height = 0.33) +
  
  # Linha 2 (GrÃ¡ficos abaixo)
  draw_plot(correlacao_deconvolucao_GAC,      x = 0.00,  y = 0.00, width = 0.50, height = 0.40) +  # Ajustei a altura
  draw_plot(correlacao_deconvolucao_PTT,     x = 0.50,  y = 0.00, width = 0.50, height = 0.40) +  # Ajustei a altura

  # Labels ajustados
  draw_plot_label(
    label = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    size = 15,
    x = c(0.00, 0.00, 0.01, 0.50),
    y = c(0.97, 0.70, 0.33, 0.33)
  )


# ExportaÃ§Ã£o recomendada
ggsave("figura_decon_customizado_xmeeting.pdf", plot = final_plot, width = 20, height = 25, units = "in", dpi = 300)

ggsave("figura_decon_customizado_xmeeting.tiff", final_plot,  width = 20, height = 25, units = "in", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
